type.description: Discriminator: the citation comes from a comment.

id.description: Parsed id of the citing comment.

author.description: Account uid of the citing comment's author.

time.description: Creation time of the blob that contains the citation.

type.description: Discriminator: the citation comes from a document.

id.description: Parsed id of the citing document, at the version that contains the citation.

author.description: Account uid of the author of the citing change.

time.description: Creation time of the blob that contains the citation.

source.description: The citing resource: a comment (`c`) or a document (`d`).

isExactVersion.description: Whether the link pins the exact target version rather than a suggested minimum version.

targetFragment.description: The block, and optional range within it, the link points at, or `null` for the whole resource.

targetId.description: Parsed id of the resource being cited.

description: One mention of a target resource from a document or comment, with its version pinning and target fragment.
